title: A Tiny Pirate in the Window

hints.text: After the Pirates area, inspect the display windows at Pieces of Eight instead of walking straight past.
Look for a small figure styled like a familiar movie pirate rather than a full-size prop.
The target is the Captain Jack Sparrow-style voodoo doll in the Pieces of Eight window.

revealDescription: A small Captain Jack Sparrow-style voodoo doll is hidden among the Pieces of Eight display details.
